process.name: Utility - JSON
process.narrative: An object for parsing JSON into a collection and turning a collection into JSON.

stage.name: Stage1
JSON to Collection
stage.narrative: Converts the input JSON text into a Collection.

stage.name: new
stage.narrative:
Clean Up Page
This is an optional page where you might choose to perform some finalisation (or "cleanup") tasks as your business object is closed down.
The cleanup action will be called automatically immediately after closing your business object at the end of a business process.
You will not be able to call this action from a business process, nor will it be called at any other time than before the disposal of the business object.

stage.name: Collection to JSON
stage.narrative: Converts an input Collection to JSON.

stage.name: JSON to Collection (skipping JArray)
stage.narrative: Converts the input JSON text into a Collection without using an intermediary JArray construct.

stage.name: JsonPath
stage.narrative: Uses JSONPath to locate element(s) within the input JSON.

stage.name: Process Json - Single Output
JsonPath - Return Collection
stage.narrative: Uses JSONPath to process the input JSON and returns a Collection.

stage.name: JsonPath - Return Object
stage.narrative: This allows multiple objects to be returned as a Json string.

stage.name: Collection to JSON using Name/Values
stage.narrative: This action expects the input data collection to have 2 columns only called Name and Value. The Name column will be used to construct the name of the JSON element, and the value of the Value column will be used as the value of the JSON element.

stage.name: JsonPath - Return Collection - Using JArray
stage.narrative: This action allows the selection of specific columns from a json array. It selects, based on the jsonpath, and then returns a collection which is then assimilated into a JArray and then this is converted to a json string.

stage.name: JsonPath - Return Object - SelectTokens
stage.narrative: This allows multiple objects to be returned as a Json string.
